• First, they ask to see your bank balance.
• Then, they delay your foreclosure request (claiming it takes 2 months).
• If you insist on faster processing, they shamelessly ask you to pay 2 extra EMIs.
• Even after waiting 2 months, they add an extra EMI + other charges in the foreclosure letter.

I had an extremely disappointing experience with Motilal Oswal after purchasing their trading software for ₹56,000. They make big promises about the software's capabilities, but in reality, it’s far from perfect. Despite assurances that they would provide training and support, I received no help whatsoever. Their team was very persistent with calls before the purchase, but once the payment was made, they became unresponsive.

From my personal experience, I feel that this company engages in deceptive practices. I strongly advise others to think twice before buying this software. If anyone wants more details, feel free to contact me. Avoid purchasing this software at all costs.
